```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(miloR)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(DT)
library(pheatmap)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(targets)
source(file.path("src/R/scrna-seq_utilities.R"))
```

This chapter explores cluster composition across conditions in three parts:

1. **Cluster proportions** — bubble plots and heatmaps showing the fraction of each
   cluster per `sample.name`, plus a sample × HTO tag breakdown.
2. **Milo differential abundance** — neighbourhood-level DA testing with a negative-binomial
   GLM, providing spatially resolved inference beyond fixed cluster boundaries.
3. **Cluster condition purity** — resolution sweep quantifying how purely each cluster
   maps to a single condition; identifies the resolution at which condition-pure clusters emerge.

**Conditions per subset:**

| Subset | Conditions |
|--------|-----------|
| Stroma | WT · Het |
| HSC    | WT · Het mCh− · Het mCh+ |
| MNC    | WT · mCh− · mCh+ |

For Milo, each HTO tag (`dm2_class`) within a condition is used as a biological replicate
(consistent with the pseudobulk DE approach elsewhere in this project). Cells labelled
`negative` or `multiplet` are excluded throughout.

---

## Helper functions {.unnumbered}

```{r helpers}
# ── Proportion helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

#' Long table: n and % of each cluster per grouping variable (singlets only).
cluster_pct <- function(meta, group_var) {
  meta %>%
    dplyr::filter(!dm2_class %in% c("negative", "multiplet")) %>%
    dplyr::count(.data[[group_var]], cluster, name = "n") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.data[[group_var]]) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data[[group_var]], cluster)
}

#' Long table: n and % per sample.name × dm2_class (singlets only).
cluster_pct_grid <- function(meta) {
  meta %>%
    dplyr::filter(!dm2_class %in% c("negative", "multiplet")) %>%
    dplyr::count(sample.name, dm2_class, cluster, name = "n") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(sample.name, dm2_class) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
}

# ── Bubble plots ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

.bubble_layers <- function(max_size = 18, text_size = 3) {
  list(
    geom_point(aes(size = pct, fill = pct),
               shape = 21, stroke = 0.3, colour = "grey30"),
    geom_text(aes(label = label), size = text_size,
              colour = "black", fontface = "bold"),
    scale_size_area(max_size = max_size, name = "% cells"),
    scale_fill_distiller(palette = "YlOrRd", direction = 1,
                         name = "% cells", limits = c(0, NA)),
    guides(size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "#fd8d3c")),
           fill = guide_colourbar(barwidth = 0.8, barheight = 5)),
    theme_bw(base_size = 11),
    theme(panel.grid.major  = element_line(colour = "grey92"),
          panel.grid.minor  = element_blank())
  )
}

plot_cluster_bubble <- function(meta, group_var, title = "") {
  df <- cluster_pct(meta, group_var) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      label   = ifelse(pct >= 1, sprintf("%.1f", pct), ""),
      cluster = factor(cluster,
                       levels = sort(unique(as.numeric(as.character(cluster)))))
    )
  ggplot(df, aes(.data[[group_var]], cluster)) +
    .bubble_layers(max_size = 18, text_size = 3) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = "Cluster") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1))
}

plot_cluster_bubble_grid <- function(meta, title = "") {
  df <- cluster_pct_grid(meta) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      label   = ifelse(pct >= 1, sprintf("%.1f", pct), ""),
      cluster = factor(cluster,
                       levels = sort(unique(as.numeric(as.character(cluster)))))
    )
  ggplot(df, aes(dm2_class, cluster)) +
    .bubble_layers(max_size = 14, text_size = 2.3) +
    facet_wrap(~ sample.name, nrow = 1) +
    labs(title = title, x = "HTO tag", y = "Cluster") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1),
          strip.text  = element_text(size = 9))
}

# ── Heatmap ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

plot_cluster_heatmap <- function(meta, title = "") {
  cond_map <- c(
    "Stroma_WT"          = "#4393c3", "Stroma_Het"         = "#d6604d",
    "CD41+_HSC_WT"       = "#4393c3", "CD41+ HSC_Het_mCh-" = "#74c476",
    "CD41+_HSC_Het_mCh+" = "#fd8d3c",
    "MNC_WT"             = "#4393c3", "MNC_mCh-"           = "#1a9850",
    "MNC_mCh+"           = "#d73027"
  )

  mat <- cluster_pct(meta, "sample.name") %>%
    dplyr::select(sample.name, cluster, pct) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = sample.name, values_from = pct,
                       values_fill = 0) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cluster = as.numeric(as.character(cluster))) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(cluster) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("cluster") %>%
    as.matrix()

  lab_mat <- matrix(
    ifelse(mat >= 1, sprintf("%.1f%%", mat), ""),
    nrow = nrow(mat), ncol = ncol(mat),
    dimnames = dimnames(mat)
  )

  scaled_mat <- t(scale(t(mat)))
  scaled_mat[!is.finite(scaled_mat)] <- 0

  present_cols <- intersect(colnames(mat), names(cond_map))
  if (length(present_cols) > 0) {
    col_ann     <- data.frame(Condition = names(cond_map[present_cols]),
                              row.names = present_cols)
    ann_colours <- list(Condition = cond_map[present_cols])
    names(ann_colours$Condition) <- names(cond_map[present_cols])
  } else {
    col_ann     <- NA
    ann_colours <- NA
  }

  pheatmap(
    scaled_mat,
    display_numbers      = lab_mat,
    number_color         = "grey15",
    fontsize_number      = 9,
    color                = colorRampPalette(
                             c("#2166ac", "#f7f7f7", "#b2182b"))(201),
    breaks               = seq(-2.5, 2.5, length.out = 202),
    cluster_rows         = FALSE,
    cluster_cols         = FALSE,
    border_color         = NA,
    main                 = title,
    fontsize             = 11,
    fontsize_row         = 10,
    fontsize_col         = 10,
    angle_col            = 45,
    cellwidth            = 52,
    cellheight           = 22,
    annotation_col       = col_ann,
    annotation_colors    = ann_colours,
    annotation_names_col = FALSE,
    legend_breaks        = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2),
    legend_labels        = c("−2", "−1", "0", "+1", "+2"),
    treeheight_row       = 0,
    treeheight_col       = 0
  )
}

# ── Scatter-pie UMAP ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

#' One scatter-pie per group, placed at the PCA-space medoid cell's UMAP coords.
#' Pie fill = proportion of fill_var levels within each group.
#' Pie area  = proportional to group size (radius scaled by sqrt(n_cells)).
#'
#' @param srt       Processed Seurat object.
#' @param group_var Metadata column defining groups (e.g. cluster column).
#' @param fill_var  Metadata column whose category proportions fill each pie.
#' @param pca_name  PCA reduction name used for medoid distance calculation.
#' @param umap_name UMAP reduction name used for pie placement.
#' @param n_pcs     Number of PCs used in distance calculation.
#' @param max_r     Radius of the largest pie in UMAP units; others scale by
#'                  sqrt(n) so that pie area is proportional to group size.
#' @param palette   Named colour vector for fill_var levels (optional).
#' @param bg_alpha  Opacity of the background cell cloud (0 = hidden).
plot_medoid_pie <- function(srt,
                            group_var,
                            fill_var,
                            pca_name  = "pca.SCT",
                            umap_name = "umap.nn",
                            n_pcs     = 20,
                            max_r     = 1.0,
                            palette   = NULL,
                            pie_alpha = 0.9,
                            bg_alpha  = 0.05) {
  pca_emb  <- Seurat::Embeddings(srt, pca_name)[, seq_len(n_pcs), drop = FALSE]
  umap_emb <- Seurat::Embeddings(srt, umap_name)
  meta     <- srt@meta.data

  groups <- as.character(unique(meta[[group_var]]))
  groups <- groups[!is.na(groups)]

  # Medoid: cell closest to the group centroid in PCA space
  medoid_idx <- vapply(groups, function(g) {
    idx  <- which(as.character(meta[[group_var]]) == g)
    if (length(idx) == 1L) return(idx)
    cent  <- colMeans(pca_emb[idx, , drop = FALSE])
    dists <- rowSums(sweep(pca_emb[idx, , drop = FALSE], 2, cent)^2)
    idx[which.min(dists)]
  }, integer(1L))

  # Proportion table: one row per group, one column per fill_var level
  prop_df <- meta %>%
    dplyr::mutate(.grp  = as.character(.data[[group_var]]),
                  .fill = as.character(.data[[fill_var]])) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.grp)) %>%
    dplyr::count(.grp, .fill, name = "n") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.grp) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(total = sum(n), prop = n / total) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols     = c(".grp", "total"),
                       names_from  = ".fill",
                       values_from = "prop",
                       values_fill = 0) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      data.frame(.grp  = groups,
                 UMAP1 = umap_emb[medoid_idx, 1],
                 UMAP2 = umap_emb[medoid_idx, 2]),
      by = ".grp"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(r = max_r * sqrt(total) / sqrt(max(total)))

  fill_cols <- setdiff(colnames(prop_df), c(".grp", "total", "UMAP1", "UMAP2", "r"))

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_point(data  = data.frame(UMAP1 = umap_emb[, 1], UMAP2 = umap_emb[, 2]),
               aes(UMAP1, UMAP2),
               size = 0.2, colour = "grey80", alpha = bg_alpha) +
    scatterpie::geom_scatterpie(
      data      = prop_df,
      aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, r = r),
      cols      = fill_cols,
      colour    = "white",
      linewidth = 0.15,
      alpha     = pie_alpha
    ) +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(fill = fill_var) +
    theme_void(base_size = 11)

  if (!is.null(palette))
    p <- p + scale_fill_manual(values = palette)

  p
}

# ── Tables ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

pct_wide <- function(meta, group_var) {
  cluster_pct(meta, group_var) %>%
    dplyr::select(-.data[["n"]]) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = cluster, values_from = pct,
                       values_fill = 0) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 1)))
}

show_pct_table <- function(meta, group_var, caption = "") {
  DT::datatable(pct_wide(meta, group_var),
                caption  = caption,
                rownames = FALSE,
                options  = list(pageLength = 20, scrollX = TRUE)) %>%
    DT::formatStyle(columns = 1, fontWeight = "bold")
}

# ── Milo visualisation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

plot_milo_results <- function(res, title = "", fdr = 0.1) {
  da        <- res$da_results
  clust_var <- res$cluster_col
  if (is.null(clust_var) || is.na(clust_var))
    clust_var <- grep("^sNN_", colnames(da), value = TRUE)[1]

  p_bee <- plotDAbeeswarm(da, group.by = clust_var, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    labs(title = paste(title, "— beeswarm"),
         x = "Cluster", y = "log2 fold-change") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  p_vol <- ggplot(da, aes(logFC, -log10(SpatialFDR),
                           colour = SpatialFDR < fdr)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(fdr), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#e31a1c", "FALSE" = "grey60"),
                        labels = c("TRUE" = paste0("DA (FDR<", fdr, ")"),
                                   "FALSE" = "n.s."),
                        name = NULL) +
    labs(title = paste(title, "— volcano"),
         x = "log2 fold-change", y = expression(-log[10](SpatialFDR))) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11)

  p_size <- ggplot(res$nhood_sizes, aes(Size)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "#4393c3", colour = "white") +
    labs(title = "Neighbourhood sizes",
         x = "Cells per neighbourhood", y = "Count") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11)

  (p_bee | p_vol) / p_size
}

plot_milo_contrasts_single <- function(res,
                                fdr = 0.1) {
  da   <- res$da_results
  clust_var <- res$cluster_col

  p_bee <- plotDAbeeswarm(da, group.by = clust_var, alpha = 0.5) +  
    ggplot2::scale_color_gradient2(
    low    = scales::muted("blue"),
    mid    =  "white",
    high   = scales::muted("red"))+
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    labs(title = paste(res$model_contrast, "— beeswarm"),
         x = "Cluster", y = "log2 FC") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  p_vol <- ggplot(da, aes(logFC, -log10(SpatialFDR),
                                   colour = SpatialFDR < fdr)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(fdr), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#fd8d3c", "FALSE" = "grey60"),
                        labels = c("TRUE" = paste0("DA (FDR<", fdr, ")"),
                                   "FALSE" = "n.s."), name = NULL) +
    labs(title = paste(res$model_contrast, "— volcano"),
         x = "log2 FC", y = expression(-log[10](SpatialFDR))) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11)
  
  p_bee/p_vol
}

plot_milo_contrasts <- function(res_two,
                                label_neg = "mCh− vs WT",
                                label_pos = "mCh+ vs WT",
                                fdr = 0.1) {
  da_neg    <- res_two$res_neg$da_results
  da_pos    <- res_two$res_pos$da_results
  clust_var <- res_two$res_neg$cluster_col
  if (is.null(clust_var) || is.na(clust_var))
    clust_var <- grep("^sNN_", colnames(da_neg), value = TRUE)[1]

  p_bee_neg <- plotDAbeeswarm(da_neg, group.by = clust_var, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    labs(title = paste(label_neg, "— beeswarm"),
         x = "Cluster", y = "log2 FC") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  p_bee_pos <- plotDAbeeswarm(da_pos, group.by = clust_var, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    labs(title = paste(label_pos, "— beeswarm"),
         x = "Cluster", y = "log2 FC") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  p_vol_neg <- ggplot(da_neg, aes(logFC, -log10(SpatialFDR),
                                   colour = SpatialFDR < fdr)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(fdr), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#74c476", "FALSE" = "grey60"),
                        labels = c("TRUE" = paste0("DA (FDR<", fdr, ")"),
                                   "FALSE" = "n.s."), name = NULL) +
    labs(title = paste(label_neg, "— volcano"),
         x = "log2 FC", y = expression(-log[10](SpatialFDR))) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11)

  p_vol_pos <- ggplot(da_pos, aes(logFC, -log10(SpatialFDR),
                                   colour = SpatialFDR < fdr)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(fdr), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#fd8d3c", "FALSE" = "grey60"),
                        labels = c("TRUE" = paste0("DA (FDR<", fdr, ")"),
                                   "FALSE" = "n.s."), name = NULL) +
    labs(title = paste(label_pos, "— volcano"),
         x = "log2 FC", y = expression(-log[10](SpatialFDR))) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11)

  (p_bee_neg | p_bee_pos) /
    (p_vol_neg | p_vol_pos)
}

da_table <- function(res, caption = "") {
  clust_var <- res$cluster_col
  if (is.null(clust_var) || is.na(clust_var))
    clust_var <- grep("^sNN_", colnames(res$da_results), value = TRUE)[1]

  res$da_results %>%
    dplyr::arrange(SpatialFDR) %>%
    dplyr::select(Nhood, all_of(clust_var), logFC, PValue, SpatialFDR) %>%
    dplyr::rename(Cluster = all_of(clust_var)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 4))) %>%
    DT::datatable(caption = caption, rownames = FALSE,
                  options = list(pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE)) %>%
    DT::formatStyle("SpatialFDR",
                    backgroundColor = DT::styleInterval(0.1, c("#fff0f0", "white")))
}
```

# Cell density & mixing {#sec-density}

Two complementary views of how conditions occupy UMAP space:

- **Point density** — cells coloured by local neighbourhood density, faceted by `sample.name`.
  Highlights whether conditions cluster together or spread differently.
- **Mixing metric** — per-cell score (Seurat `MixingMetric`) measuring how much a cell's
  nearest neighbours are drawn from other conditions vs its own.  Low values = well-mixed;
  high values = segregated.  WT vs Het comparison shown per compartment.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Stroma

```{r stroma-density-load}
targets::tar_load(anno_meta_cond_stroma)
```

```{r stroma-density, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
anno_meta_cond_stroma %>%
  dplyr::filter(!dm2_class %in% c("negative", "multiplet")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(UMAP1, UMAP2)) +
  ggpointdensity::geom_pointdensity() +
  facet_wrap(vars(sample.name)) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "Density") +
  labs(title = "Stroma — point density by sample") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text  = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank())
```

```{r stroma-mixing-load}
targets::tar_load(mpn_processed_data_stroma)
```

```{r stroma-mixing, fig.height=5, fig.width=6}
mpn_processed_data_stroma$gps <- ifelse(
  stringr::str_detect(mpn_processed_data_stroma$sample.name, "WT"), "WT", "Het")
mpn_processed_data_stroma$mix <- Seurat::MixingMetric(
  object       = mpn_processed_data_stroma,
  grouping.var = "gps",
  reduction    = "umap.nn")
Seurat::FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_data_stroma, "mix", reduction = "umap.nn") &
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo", name = "Mixing\nmetric") &
  labs(title = "Stroma — mixing metric (WT vs Het)")
```

```{r stroma-density-cleanup}
rm(anno_meta_cond_stroma, mpn_processed_data_stroma); gc()
```

# Cluster proportions {#sec-proportions}

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Stroma

```{r stroma-prop-load}
targets::tar_load(anno_meta_cond_stroma)
meta_stroma <- anno_meta_cond_stroma
rm(anno_meta_cond_stroma); gc()
```

```{r stroma-bubble-sample, fig.height=6, fig.width=6}
plot_cluster_bubble(meta_stroma, "sample.name",
                    title = "Stroma — % per sample")
```

```{r stroma-heatmap, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
plot_cluster_heatmap(meta_stroma,
                     title = "Stroma — row-scaled % (cluster × sample)")
```

```{r stroma-bubble-grid, fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
plot_cluster_bubble_grid(meta_stroma,
```

```{r}
df <- data.frame(mch_neg = milo_hsc_da$mChNeg_vs_WT$da_results$logFC,

df %>%

                intercept =  0,
                colour = "black",
                linewidth = 0.5,
                lty = 2)+
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
               colour = "black", 
               linewidth = 0.5, 
               lty = 2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
               colour = "black",
               linewidth = 0.5,
```

```{r}
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc[["SCT"]]@meta.features <- data.frame(row.names = rownames(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc[["SCT"]]))

                                    do.plot = FALSE)
cor_genes <- mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc[["SCT"]]@meta.features %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  mutate(dir = ifelse(mean_lfc_mChPos_vs_WT_all_rank_cor >0,"up", "down")) %>%
```

```{r }
design_df <- as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::colData(milo_hsc_obj)) %>%

  dplyr::distinct()

                  test_control = "WT",

meta_df <- SummarizedExperiment::colData(milo_hsc_obj)
nhood.dge <- testDiffExp(milo_hsc_obj,
                         da_res, 
                         design=~condition,
                         meta.data=meta_df,
                         subset.nhoods = NULL,
                         gene.offset=TRUE)
```

Group neighborhoods
```{r}
da_fdr <- 0.1

                                    milo_hsc_da$mChPos_vs_WT$da_results,
                                    compute.new = FALSE,
                                    da.fdr = da_fdr)
da_neg_groups <- miloR::groupNhoods(milo_hsc_obj,
                                    milo_hsc_da$mChNeg_vs_WT$da_results,
                                    compute.new = FALSE,
                                    da.fdr = da_fdr)
```

```{r}
                        colour_by = "NhoodGroup", layout = "umap.nn")

plt_neg <- plot_nhood_graph_groups(milo_hsc_obj, da_neg_groups,
                        colour_by = "NhoodGroup", layout = "umap.nn")

plt_pos+ggtitle("mChPos_vs_WT")|plt_neg+ggtitle("mChNeg_vs_WT")
```

Plot groups on cell UMAP
```{r}
nhood_mat    <- miloR::nhoods(milo_hsc_obj)          # cells × nhoods (sparse)
n_membership <- Matrix::rowSums(nhood_mat)           # nhoods per cell

grp_vec <- setNames(da_pos_groups$NhoodGroup, as.character(da_pos_groups$Nhood))
grp_aligned <- as.numeric(grp_vec[as.character(seq_len(ncol(nhood_mat)))])

# Using model.matrix
grp_mat <- model.matrix(~ factor(grp_aligned) - 1)
colnames(grp_mat) <- levels(factor(grp_aligned))

cell_grp_mat  <- nhood_mat %*% grp_mat
cell_grp_vec <- apply(cell_grp_mat,1,which.max)

mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc$milo_ngb_grps <- cell_grp_vec
DimPlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, group.by =  "milo_ngb_grps", label = TRUE)& NoLegend()
```

# Cluster condition purity

For each compartment, `FindClusters` is re-run across a range of resolutions on
the cached SNN graph. At each resolution and for each cluster, **purity** is the
fraction of cells belonging to the dominant condition. Points are sized by
within-resolution rank of cluster size; boxes summarise the purity distribution
per dominant condition.

```{r purity-setup}
targets::tar_load(purity_cluster_res)

prep_purity <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      resolution = factor(resolution, levels = as.character(purity_cluster_res))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(resolution, cluster) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      dominant_condition = dominant_condition,
      n_cells            = n_cells,
      weighted_purity    = sum(purity * n_cells) / sum(n_cells),
      .groups            = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(resolution) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      n_r      = rank(n_cells),
      n_scaled = n_r / max(n_r)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
}
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Stroma

```{r purity-stroma-load}
targets::tar_load(condition_purity_stroma)
wp2 <- prep_purity(condition_purity_stroma)
```

```{r purity-stroma-plot, fig.height=4, fig.width=8}
ggplot(data = wp2,
       aes(x = as.factor(resolution), y = weighted_purity,
           fill = dominant_condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.3,
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
               outliers = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(aes(size = n_scaled),
              alpha = 0.5, shape = 21, color = "black",
              show.legend = FALSE,
              position = position_jitterdodge(
                jitter.width = 0.4, dodge.width = 0.9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 3) +
  labs(x = "Resolution", y = "Weighted mean purity",
       fill = "Dominant condition") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)
```

```{r purity-stroma-cleanup}
rm(condition_purity_stroma, wp2); gc()
```

```{r purity-hsc-groups-umap, fig.height=5, fig.width=14}
#| fig-cap: "UMAP split by purity group (resolution 10, purity cutoff 0.6). Pure clusters

groups    <- sort(unique(purity_group_hsc$purity_group))

  setNames(scales::hue_pal()(sum(groups != "Impure")), groups[groups != "Impure"]),
  Impure = "grey70"
)

  geom_point(size = 0.4, stroke = 0, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = group_pal, name = "Purity group") +
  facet_wrap(~ purity_group) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1))) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
        aspect.ratio = 1)
```
